name: Color
why: DLSS-SR input; without it EvaluateFeature has nothing to upscale

name: Depth
why: DLSS-SR input; the temporal reprojection needs it

name: MotionVectors
why: DLSS-SR input; without it the history cannot be reprojected

name: Output
why: DLSS-SR destination; required by the feature contract

name: Jitter.Offset.X
why: proven required: NGX feature log said 'could not find Jitter.Offset.X parameter' and EvaluateFeature answered 0xBAD00005 (2026-10-25 18:57, nvngx_dlss_310_5_3.log)

name: Jitter.Offset.Y
why: the y half of the same required pair

name: Reset
why: every DLSS sample sets it; not yet proven that omitting it fails validation

name: MV.Scale.X
why: SDK samples always set the MV scale; this runtime exposes MV.Scale.X, but a missing value has not been proven to fail EvaluateFeature here
